added.description: `mcp/bridge`: `Bridge.ToSkill()` mounts a remote MCP session as a local `skill.Skill`, proxying tool calls through the session
`migration`: `AdaptTool`/`AdaptSkill` wrap legacy tool/skill types to implement `skill.Tool`/`skill.Skill`
`migration`: `Check()` validates registry migration completeness and reports actionable issues
`registry`: `Capability` type with standard constants (file, http, code, git, database, communication, search, etc.) and `CapabilityProvider`/`KeywordProvider` interfaces
`registry`: `DiscoveryRegistry` interface with `FindByCapability`, `FindByCapabilities`, `FindByAnyCapability`, `FindByKeyword`, `FindByCategory`, `RegisterCapabilities`
`clawhub`: `Hub.Discover()` and `Hub.RecommendSkills()` for capability-based marketplace search and natural-language recommendations
`installer`: `VersionConstraint` and `SemVer` types supporting exact, range, caret (`^`), tilde (`~`), and `latest`/`*` version pinning
`pack`: `PublishConfig`/`PublishBundle` prepare a validated, checksummed tarball for publishing a skill pack
`pack`: SKILL.md validation with `ValidationResult`/`ValidationError`, distinguishing errors from warnings
`pack`: scaffolding helper for generating new `SkillPack` directory structures
`mcp/oauth2`: `RevocationHandler()` implements RFC 7009 token revocation for access and refresh tokens
`mcp/transport`: WebSocket transport evaluation stub
`mcp/server`: rate-limiting middleware (token bucket, per-client key, configurable burst) and tool authorization middleware
`mcp/server`: `LoggingMiddleware` for structured request logging via `slog`
`roles`: reference role implementations `CodeReviewer` (configurable strictness) and `MeetingPM`
`role`: `ValidateSkills()` checks a role's required/optional skills against a registry with actionable error messages
`role`: `Version() string` added to the `Role` interface and `BaseRole`
`skill`: `Version() string` added to the `Skill` interface and `BaseSkill`
`skill`: JSON Schema fields added to `Parameter` for richer tool input schemas
